tool_args.rationale: The observed saturating response and pilot signatures favor the bridge-mapped siphon mechanism, but constant s_grad leaves branch sign and sink inhibition confounded. Acquire the low-cost open-branch discriminating probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows have identical s_grad, so sink inhibition and the open-branch term are not identifiable; source notes require an open-branch probe when s_grad span is below 0.08.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit static quadratic or Michaelis-Menten alternatives
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They do not resolve branch sign or sink-gradient dependence and are less consistent with the bridge thermal-fin and flux-conservation signatures.
The evidence points to the static siphon bridge rather than a coupled memory ODE; this batch is unnecessary at the current horizon.
